title: The 36-Inch Saree Border Mystery
scenario: Tiruchirappalli Central Jail in Tamil Nadu runs a saree-weaving unit famous across South India. Inmates weave the border using a single repeating motif — mango, peacock, mango, peacock — over and over. Each motif occupies exactly 6 inches of fabric. A new order has come in for a 36-inch border that must end cleanly on a full motif (no half-mango, no half-peacock). You have the motif written out as the string 'MangoPeacock' — and Python gives you a remarkably concise way to repeat a string a fixed number of times. What one expression builds the full 36-inch border?
